single.rationale: Bloomin' Brands shows severe operational deterioration with operating margin collapsing from 7.6% (2022) to 0.9% (2025) and flat revenue growth while facing structural headwinds in casual dining. The announced turnaround strategy, dividend suspension, and goodwill impairment signal distress rather than opportunity, with management focused on debt paydown over growth amid persistent margin compression from labor and commodity inflation.

The company requires both margin recovery and revenue growth to justify even the current depressed valuation, but faces intense competition from casual dining, supermarkets and fast-casual operators while attempting to fund an ambitious remodel program with declining operating cash flow (from $532.4M in 2023 to $276.7M in 2025). This is a show-me turnaround at best; wait for at least two consecutive quarters of positive Outback comparable sales and margin stabilization before reconsidering.
